ports.description: Debug status: Core is halted

ports.description: Interrupt acknowledge

ports.description: Interrupt index for taken interrupt

ports.name: instr_addr_o
ports.description: Address, word aligned

ports.name: instr_req_o
ports.description: Request valid, will stay high until ``instr_gnt_i`` is high for one cycle

ports.name: instr_gnt_i
ports.description: The other side accepted the request. ``instr_addr_o`` may change in the next cycle.

ports.name: instr_rvalid_i
ports.description: ``instr_rdata_i`` holds valid data when ``instr_rvalid_i`` is high. This signal will be high for exactly one cycle per request.

ports.name: rst_ni
ports.description: Active-low asynchronous reset

ports.name: clk_i
ports.description: Clock signal

ports.name: scan_cg_en_i
ports.description: Scan clock gate enable. Design for test (DfT) related signal. Can be used during scan testing operation to force instantiated clock gate(s) to be enabled. This signal should be 0 during normal / functional operation.

ports.name: fetch_enable_i
ports.description: Enable the instruction fetch of CV32E40P. The first instruction fetch after reset de-assertion will not happen as long as this signal is 0. ``fetch_enable_i`` needs to be set to 1 for at least one cycle while not in reset to enable fetching. Once fetching has been enabled the value ``fetch_enable_i`` is ignored.

ports.name: core_sleep_o
ports.description: Core is sleeping, see :ref:`sleep_unit`.

ports.name: pulp_clock_en_i
ports.description: PULP clock enable (only used when ``COREV_CLUSTER`` = 1, tie to 0 otherwise), see :ref:`sleep_unit`

ports.name: boot_addr_i
ports.description: Boot address. First program counter after reset = ``boot_addr_i``. Must be half-word aligned. Do not change after enabling core via ``fetch_enable_i``

ports.name: mtvec_addr_i
ports.description: ``mtvec`` address. Initial value for the address part of :ref:`csr-mtvec`. Do not change after enabling core via ``fetch_enable_i``

ports.name: hart_id_i
ports.description: Hart ID, usually static, can be read from :ref:`csr-mhartid` and :ref:`csr-uhartid` CSRs

ports.name: data_addr_o
ports.description: Address

ports.name: data_req_o
ports.description: Request valid, will stay high until ``data_gnt_i`` is high for one cycle

ports.name: data_gnt_i
ports.description: The other side accepted the request. ``data_addr_o`` may change in the next cycle.

ports.name: data_we_o
ports.description: Write Enable, high for writes, low for reads. Sent together with ``data_req_o``

ports.name: data_be_o
ports.description: Byte Enable. Is set for the bytes to write/read, sent together with ``data_req_o``

ports.name: data_wdata_o
ports.description: Data to be written to memory, sent together with ``data_req_o``

ports.name: data_rvalid_i
ports.description: ``data_rvalid_i`` will be high for exactly one cycle to signal the end of the response phase of for both read and write

ports.name: data_rdata_i
ports.description: Data read from memory

instantiation_template:
cv32e40p_top #(
    .FPU                      ( 0 ),
    .FPU_ADDMUL_LAT           ( 0 ),
    .FPU_OTHERS_LAT           ( 0 ),
    .ZFINX                    ( 0 ),
    .COREV_PULP               ( 0 ),
    .COREV_CLUSTER            ( 0 ),
    .NUM_MHPMCOUNTERS         ( 1 )
) u_core (
    // Clock and reset
    .rst_ni                   (),
    .clk_i                    (),
    .scan_cg_en_i             (),

    // Special control signals
    .fetch_enable_i           (),
    .pulp_clock_en_i          (),
    .core_sleep_o             (),

    // Configuration
    .boot_addr_i              (),
    .mtvec_addr_i             (),
    .dm_halt_addr_i           (),
    .dm_exception_addr_i      (),
    .hart_id_i                (),

    // Instruction memory interface
    .instr_addr_o             (),
    .instr_req_o              (),
    .instr_gnt_i              (),
    .instr_rvalid_i           (),
    .instr_rdata_i            (),

    // Data memory interface
    .data_addr_o              (),
    .data_req_o               (),
    .data_gnt_i               (),
    .data_we_o                (),
    .data_be_o                (),
    .data_wdata_o             (),
    .data_rvalid_i            (),
    .data_rdata_i             (),

     // Interrupt interface
    .irq_i                    (),
    .irq_ack_o                (),
    .irq_id_o                 (),

    // Debug interface
    .debug_req_i              (),
    .debug_havereset_o        (),
    .debug_running_o          (),
    .debug_halted_o           ()
);

synthesis_targets.name: fmax_prose_100mhz_on_a_32_kb_memory_connected_on_each_of_its_obi_interface
synthesis_targets.target_fpga: a 32 KB memory connected on each of its OBI interface

parameters.name: FPU_ADDMUL_LAT
parameters.description: Number of pipeline registers for Floating-Point addition and multiplication instructions, see :ref:`fpu`

parameters.name: FPU_OTHERS_LAT
parameters.description: Number of pipeline registers for Floating-Point comparison, conversion and classify instructions, see :ref:`fpu`

parameters.name: ZFINX
parameters.description: Enable Floating Point instructions to use the General Purpose register file instead of requiring a dedicated Floating Point register file, see :ref:`fpu`. Only allowed to be set to 1 if ``FPU`` = 1

parameters.name: COREV_PULP
parameters.description: Enable all of the custom PULP ISA extensions (except **cv.elw**) (see :ref:`custom-isa-extensions`) and all custom CSRs (see :ref:`cs-registers`).

parameters.name: NUM_MHPMCOUNTERS
parameters.description: Number of MHPMCOUNTER performance counters, see :ref:`performance-counters`

parameters.name: FPU
parameters.description: Enable Floating Point Unit (FPU) support, see :ref:`fpu`
